geckolib: 4.8.4 (pinned jar on the g1 runtime classpath)

F_spline_args_model.note: arithmetic model of the two spline-argument rules on the gait amplitude; the measured GeckoLib numbers are in B

G_layered_composition.note: GeckoLib writes each controller's pose absolutely (setRotX(value + initialSnapshot)); two controllers on one bone = last registered wins. The LAYERED variant adds its scaled delta to the bone's accumulated delta and composes.

H_constants.classic_reference: G1AnimationRuntime transcription of ModelBeaver.setupAnim, internal basis (rff/lrf = -gait, lff/rrf = +gait, teeth = -cos*pi*0.25, tail = -cos*pi*0.05), float chain as compiled
